title: Firefox profiles (Snap install)
whyItMatters: Ubuntu ships Firefox as a Snap. The profile inside the Snap tree holds the same history, bookmarks, cookies and saved logins, and is easy to miss because the normal Firefox folder is empty.
source: Ubuntu has shipped Firefox as a Snap since 22.04; the confined profile lives under ~/snap/firefox/common/.mozilla/firefox: https://askubuntu.com/questions/1414757/where-does-firefox-snap-store-the-profiles
notes: Snap keeps per-app data under ~/snap/<name>/<revision|common>; Firefox uses the common slot so profiles survive revisions. On Ubuntu 22.04+ the native ~/.mozilla/firefox folder usually does not exist.
